title: MailLabel
description: Semantic tag for mail. Labels are not folders — a message can carry many labels. System labels (imbox, feed, paper_trail) are fixed routing slots. User labels are arbitrary. AI-suggested labels are provisional until confirmed.

labelClass.description: system=built-in routing slot. user=manually created. ai_suggested=provisional AI tag. workroom=linked to a professional workroom. topic=aligned to 22-topic canon.

topicCode.description: If labelClass=topic, the TriTRPC topic code this label aligns to (e.g. 'pol', 'wfl', 'lrn')
